name: Torrey Highlands · San Diego

provenance.strategy: Retain the original snapshot records and order; append new feature IDs from the expanded OSM export, sorted by type and ID. Original records win for overlapping IDs so reviewed geometry remains unchanged.

map3d.implementation: Executes the pinned upstream areaData extrusion function; replaces its 51000 arbitrary scale with a local metric projection and supplies explicit inferred heights where OSM has none.

mesaVerdeAthletics.reference: User-supplied Mesa Verde map screenshot; approximate placement and dimensions.

schoolDetails.provenance: Deterministic artistic architectural and campus details; mapped OSM footprints and heights retained. Court, play, shade, and paths are approximate authored placements, not surveyed architecture.

assumptions: Flat stylized terrain; no surveyed elevation model.

Building footprints, roads, campus, plaza, parks, and sport surfaces use OpenStreetMap geometry. Missing building heights: homes 6.5 m, offices/commercial 12 m, Westview 8.5 m, plaza 7 m. Supplied OSM levels retain Map3D's 2.2 m/level convention.
Window panels, flat roof colors, and supplemental trees are deterministic artistic details, not surveyed architecture or vegetation.
Mesa Verde athletics field and north-south oval track are authored from the user reference within the mapped school parcel; placement and dimensions are approximate.
Road widths are inferred from tagged lane counts or highway class where explicit widths are absent. Mapped bridges are raised to 5.9 m with 70 m approach ramps.
All landmark buildings, roofs, and facade panels are merged into one selectable mesh per destination. Mesa Verde also includes its authored athletics field and track in that same selectable mesh.

excluded: building footprint plus canopy radius + 1 m
road/path half-width plus canopy radius + 1 m
parking, sports, authored school surfaces and entrance canopies plus canopy radius + 1 m
